headline: Bitcoin Drops 20% in Two Weeks Amid Rate Concerns and Risk Aversion
summary: Bitcoin has dropped 20% over the past two weeks as risk aversion, stubborn inflation readings, and expectations of elevated central bank interest rates damp demand across digital asset markets.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, often acting as a high-beta indicator of global liquidity and investor appetite for speculative assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Tight monetary policy expectations and widespread risk aversion triggered substantial selling in crypto tokens.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bitcoin suffered a 20% two-week decline as rising bond yields and prospects of extended central bank policy tightening sparked selling in crypto assets.
